description: PROP-AUTH-020 (Tier 2, REQ-AUTH-011) is described by verification-architecture.md as 'Integration test: spawn process with missing vars'. The actual test at auth-flow.test.ts:316-365 calls validateRequiredEnvVars (a pure core function) with missing env vars and checks the return value. This is functionally identical to PROP-AUTH-034 (Tier 1) which tests the exact same function with the same approach in pure-core.test.ts:569-635. The Tier 2 test does not spawn a process, does not test the integration of env var validation with the startup sequence, and provides zero additional integration-boundary confidence beyond Tier 1. The contract describes this as 'tested (calls validateRequiredEnvVars for each missing var)' which is accurate for what the test does, but misrepresents the Tier 2 integration requirement from the verification architecture.
